title: How OpenAI delivers low-latency voice AI at scale
summary: How OpenAI rebuilt its WebRTC stack to power real-time Voice AI with low latency, global scale, and seamless conversational turn-taking.
body: How OpenAI rebuilt its WebRTC stack to power real-time Voice AI with low latency, global scale, and seamless conversational turn-taking.
summaryZh: OpenAI分享了其通过重构WebRTC技术栈，实现大规模实时语音AI低延迟交互的技术路径，重点解决了全球化部署下的对话响应速度问题。原始信息显示：How OpenAI rebuilt its WebRTC stack to power real-time Voice AI with low latency, global scale, and seamless conversational turn-taking.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“How OpenAI delivers low-latency voice AI at scale”。其重要性主要体现在：该文详细介绍了实时语音AI的底层架构优化，对工程实践具有参考意义。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
